questions.text: Should a simultaneous up and down press cancel, or should one direction take priority?
questions.default: Cancel the two count actions; centre clear takes priority over both.
questions.answer: Up takes priority over down; clear takes priority over both.
questions.evidence: If several presses land on the same clock, only the highest priority acts - clear, then up, then down.

questions.reason: The request requires bounce immunity but gives no interval.

questions.text: What exact brightness-to-duty mapping should be used for all 256 values?
questions.default: Use linear 8-bit duty with zero off and 255 full on, using a 256-cycle PWM period.
questions.reason: PWM is required but resolution and endpoint semantics are unspecified.
questions.answer: Use linear 8-bit duty: 0 is fully off, and each value lights the LEDs for that many phase counts out of 256. Thus 255 is on for 255/256 of the period, not fully on.
questions.evidence: - DUTY_EFF = 0 is fully off; 255 is on 255/256 of the time. Brightness is linear in DUTY_EFF (no gamma).

questions.text: What brightness should be active after reset, and should reset select UART or switch brightness?
questions.default: Reset brightness to zero and select the UART brightness register.
questions.reason: Reset behavior is requested but initial brightness and source selection are not stated.
questions.answer: After reset, brightness is 0x40 (64), using the DUTY register—not the switches. UART brightness selection is not specified.

questions.text: What precise meaning of no-flicker and acceptable brightness/display refresh is required?
questions.default: Use 256-cycle LED PWM and 100000-cycle per-digit scanning at 100 MHz.
questions.reason: No numerical flicker or refresh threshold is given.
questions.answer: The specified board settings are a 1024-clock LED PWM period (about 97.7 kHz) and 2^17 clocks per digit, giving an 8-digit refresh of about 95 Hz. The specification does not define a separate general threshold for “no-flicker” or acceptable refresh. The proposed 256-cycle PWM and 100000-cycle digit scan are not the specified settings.

  REFRESH_BITS: 17             # each display digit is lit for 2^17 clocks = 1.31 ms; 8 digits = 10.5 ms (95 Hz)
